# Experience Usambara Mountains Tours

Local tour guide in Lushoto, Usambara Mountains, Tanzania.
Owner and guide: Kibwana Hussein Ngoda.

## Offer
- Rainforest hikes (Magamba rainforest, waterfalls)
- Multi-day treks (village to village, viewpoints)
- Wildlife walks (chameleons, endemic birds, colobus monkeys)
- Driving tours and cultural village tours
